item.title: High pressure builds following a wintry February week
item.description: The bottom line? A series of storms delivered heavy mountain and widespread valley snow during the work week, but the weekend brings a warming trend and drier skies.

item.title: Utah high school wrestling championship causes measles outbreak among students, attendees
item.description: A Utah state high school wrestling championship has caused an outbreak of measles cases after participants and attendees were exposed at the event last weekend, according to the Utah Dept. of Health and Human Services (DHHS).

item.title: Avalanche in Big Cottonwood Canyon leaves 2 seriously injured
item.description: The Salt Lake County Sheriff's Office Search and Rescue Team is currently responding to an avalanche in Big Cottonwood Canyon.

item.title: Wrong-way crash on I-80 near Magna leaves 1 dead, others in critical condition
item.description: The eastbound lanes of I-80 have been closed in Salt Lake County near the border of Tooele County due to a crash, according to Utah Highway Patrol (UHP).

item.title: UPDATE: One injured, evacuated after second avalanche erupted in Big Cottonwood Canyon
item.description: A second avalanche has been reported in Big Cottonwood Canyon, injuring at least one person.

item.title: Over 100 pounds of illegal narcotics seized in Utah County drug bust
item.description: An anonymous tip led to a seizure of over 100 pounds of illegal narcotics with a street value of at least $176,000.

item.title: One seriously injured, three others hospitalized after two-vehicle crash in Kearns
item.description: Four people have been transported to the hospital after a vehicle accident in Kearns and one is seriously injured.

item.title: 'Must be worked on IMMEDIATELY': President Trump pledges action to save the Great Salt Lake
item.description: President Donald Trump has expressed interest in the vitality of the Great Salt Lake and has pledged to work with Utah Governor Spencer Cox to help save it.
